50201-the-young-oarsmen-of-lakeview.title: Young Oarsmen Of Lakeview.
50201-the-young-oarsmen-of-lakeview.creator: Unknown
50201-the-young-oarsmen-of-lakeview.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Quicker than it can be related, four oars fell into the water and four sturdy arms bent to the task of sending two beautiful single-shell craft skimming over the smooth surface of the lake.

75967-dr-mabuse-master-of-mystery.title: _A Novel_
75967-dr-mabuse-master-of-mystery.creator: Norbert Jacques
75967-dr-mabuse-master-of-mystery.description: A book by Norbert Jacques. nd his scarf-pin was a single white pearl in a somewhat quaint setting, its dazzling purity recalling the whiteness of a lovely blonde’s shoulders, as Karstens remarked. Moreover, he at once placed a sum of twenty thousand marks upon the table in front of him.

arxiv-1806-04030.title: Search for pair production of higgsinos in final states with at least three b b -tagged jets in s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV p ​ p pp collisions using the ATLAS detector
arxiv-1806-04030.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-1806-04030.description: Abstract A search for pair production of the supersymmetric partners of the Higgs boson (higgsinos H ~ \tilde{H} ) in gauge-mediated scenarios is reported. Each higgsino is assumed to decay to a Higgs boson and a gravitino. Two complementary analyses, targeting high- and low-mass signals, are performed to maximize sensitivity.

arxiv-2103-13066.title: Additive and multiplicative Sidon sets
arxiv-2103-13066.creator: Oliver Roche-Newton, Audie Warren
arxiv-2103-13066.description: Abstract . We give a construction of a set A ⊂ ℕ A\subset\mathbb{N} such that any subset A ′ ⊂ A A^{\prime}\subset A with | A ′ | ≫ | A | 2 / 3 |A^{\prime}|\gg|A|^{2/3} is neither an additive nor multiplicative Sidon set. In doing so, we refute a conjecture of Klurman and Pohoata. 1.

arxiv-2209-00492.title: Tom G. Mackay
arxiv-2209-00492.description: Abstract Towards Morphologically Induced Anisotropy in Thermally Hysteretic Dielectric Properties of Vanadium Dioxide Abstract The Bruggeman homogenization formalism was used to numerically investigate the dielectric properties of a columnar thin film (CTF) made from vanadium dioxide. For visible and near-infrared wavelengths, the CTF is electromagnetically equivalent to a homogeneous orthorhombic material.

arxiv-2308-07963.title: Extended body dynamics in general relativity: Hyperelastic models
arxiv-2308-07963.creator: Nishita Jadoo, J. David Brown, Charles R. Evans
arxiv-2308-07963.description: Abstract We present a numerical framework for modeling extended hyperelastic bodies based on a Lagrangian formulation of general relativistic elasticity theory. We use finite element methods to discretize the body, then use the semi–discrete action to derive ordinary differential equations of motion for the discrete nodes. The nodes are evolved in time using fourth–order Runge–Kutta.

arxiv-2407-09446.title: Neutron-quark stars: Discerning viable alternatives for the higher-density part of the equation of state of compact stars
arxiv-2407-09446.creator: Sudipta Hensh, Yong-Jia Huang, Toru Kojo, Luca Baiotti, Kentaro Takami, Shigehiro Nagataki, Hajime Sotani
arxiv-2407-09446.description: Abstract We investigate binary neutron star (BNS) mergers using general-relativistic numerical simulations with hadronic and hybrid equations of state (EOSs), incorporating the latest observations and theoretical constraints. We address two viable scenarios for the transition to quark matter: a quark-hadron crossover (QHC) or a strong first-order phase transition (1PT).

arxiv-2407-17629.title: Papilusion at DAGPap24: Paper or Illusion? Detecting AI-generated Scientific Papers
arxiv-2407-17629.creator: Nikita Andreev, Alexander Shirnin, Vladislav Mikhailov, Ekaterina Artemova
arxiv-2407-17629.description: Abstract This paper presents Papilusion, an AI-generated scientific text detector developed within the DAGPap24 shared task on detecting automatically generated scientific papers. We propose an ensemble-based approach and conduct ablation studies to analyze the effect of the detector configurations on the performance. Papilusion is ranked 6th on the leaderboard, and we improve our performance after the competition ended, achieving 99.

arxiv-2408-08943.title: Generalizing the Index of the u u -Deformed Homogeneous Polynomials and Generating Functions for R - ​ n ​ ( x , y ; q | u ) \mathrm{R}_{\textup{{-}}n}(x,y;q|u)
arxiv-2408-08943.creator: Ronald Orozco López
arxiv-2408-08943.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ronald Orozco López. This paper introduces the u u -deformed homogeneous functions R α ​ ( x , y ; u | q ) \mathrm{R}_{\alpha}(x,y;u|q) , for all α ∈ ℂ \alpha\in\mathbb{C} . Basic properties of the functions R α ​ ( x , y ; u | q ) \mathrm{R}_{\alpha}(x,y;u|q) are given, along with recurrence relations, their q q -difference equation, and representations.

arxiv-2505-21263.title: JavaSith: A Client-Side Framework for Analyzing Potentially Malicious Extensions in Browsers, VS Code, and NPM Packages
arxiv-2505-21263.creator: Avihay Cohen
arxiv-2505-21263.description: Abstract Modern software supply chains face an increasing threat from malicious code hidden in trusted components such as browser extensions, IDE extensions, and open-source packages. This paper introduces JavaSith , a novel client-side framework for analyzing potentially malicious extensions in web browsers, Visual Studio Code (VSCode), and Node’s NPM packages. JavaSith combines a runtime sandbox that emulates browser/Node.

arxiv-2601-15731.title: FAIR-ESI : Feature Adaptive Importance Refinement for Electrophysiological Source Imaging Thanks:
arxiv-2601-15731.creator: Linyong Zou †,1,2 , Liang Zhang †,1,2,3 , Xiongfei Wang †,4 , Jia-Hong Gao 5 , Yi Sun 2 , Shurong Sheng 2 , Kuntao Xiao 2 , Wanli Yang 2 , Pengfei Teng 4 , Guoming Luan ∗,4 , Zhao Lv ∗,6 and Zikang Xu ∗,2
arxiv-2601-15731.description: Abstract An essential technique for diagnosing brain disorders is electrophysiological source imaging (ESI). While model-based optimization and deep learning methods have achieved promising results in this field, the accurate selection and refinement of features remains a central challenge for precise ESI.

arxiv-2604-12407.title: Tamper-Proofing with Self-Modifying Code
arxiv-2604-12407.creator: Gregory Morse morse@inf.elte.hu, Tamás Kozsik kto@elte.hu

pmc-12539784.title: An Atypical Presentation of Giant Cell Arteritis in an Elderly Patient: Diplopia and Fever Masked by Pneumonia
pmc-12539784.creator: Aleena Anna George, Solomon Yimer
pmc-12539784.description: Giant cell arteritis (GCA) is a chronic vasculitis typically affecting individuals over 50 years of age, often presenting with headache, jaw claudication, scalp tenderness, or visual symptoms. We report an 86-year-old male with psoriasis and hypertension who presented with cough, fever, night sweats, headache, and binocular diplopia, initially managed as pneumonia and possible stroke.

pmc-12540865.title: Optimal tracking consensus for swarm systems with leader-following switching topologies
pmc-12540865.creator: Qian Zhang, Cheng Wang, Miao Zhao, Jianxiang Xi, Yuanshi Zheng
pmc-12540865.description: For swarm systems with leader-following switching topologies, optimal tracking consensus achievement problems are investigated. First, by these errors of the cooperative states among neighboring agents, a new tracking strategy with an optimization index is proposed to realize the optimal tracking consensus. The optimization index contains a tracking consensus performance term and a control energy consumption term.

pmc-12699808.title: Multilevel analysis of improved water utilization and associated factors in Yemen: using 2013 DHS Yemen national dataset
pmc-12699808.creator: Lamrot Yohannes, Mengesha Genet, Sisay Deme, Asmare Asrat Yirdaw, Mequannent Sharew Melaku
pmc-12699808.description: Access to clean drinking water is essential for public health and quality of life. Yemen faces a severe water crisis driven by scarcity, groundwater overexploitation, and socio-political instability. This study analyzed data from the 2013 Yemen Demographic and Health Survey (17,333 weighted samples from 8,794 households) to identify household and community factors influencing access to improved water sources.

pmc-13158780.title: Mechanisms of search for specific sites in DNA by DNA-binding proteins
pmc-13158780.creator: Maria V. Lukina, Olga S. Fedorova, Alexander A. Chernonosov, Vladimir V. Koval
pmc-13158780.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Efficient recognition of specific sites in DNA by repair proteins requires resolution of the fundamental “speed–stability paradox.” This paradox arises from the need to scan a vast genome rapidly while maintaining high accuracy in lesion detection. Classical models of protein–DNA interactions have shown that the association rate constants for site-specific complexes can approach or even exceed the diffusion limit, implying the existence of specialized mechanisms of facilitated, or accelerated, diffusion.

pmc-13332445.title: Mechanisms, clinical manifestations and management of cardiovascular diseases in ANCA-associated vasculitis
pmc-13332445.creator: Emanuele Chiara, Giacomo Bagni, Alessandro Raho, Filippo Fagni, Aladdin J Mohammad, Giacomo Emmi
pmc-13332445.description: ANCA-associated vasculitides (AAVs) are rare diseases characterized by small-vessel necrotizing vasculitis, multiorgan involvement and positivity for ANCAs. The main phenotypes are granulomatosis with polyangiitis, microscopic polyangiitis and eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis, representing distinct yet partially overlapping entities in terms of pathogenesis, clinical expression and therapeutic management.

pmc-13459582.title: Draft genome sequence of Streptococcus infantarius strain UMPGM isolated from individual withdrawing from methamphetamine
pmc-13459582.creator: Siti Khadijah Kiraman, Norafisah Mohd Arshad, Hajar Fauzan Ahmad
pmc-13459582.description: We report draft the genome sequence of Streptococcus infantarius strain UMPGM (1,791,962 bp, guanine-cytosine [GC] content of 37.70%) isolated from an individual recovering from methamphetamine use disorder. The organism was isolated from a stool sample on de Man, Rogosa, and Sharpe agar under anaerobic condition.

pmc-13532928.title: Dramatic Improvement of Treatment-Refractory Prurigo Nodularis Following Initiation of Semaglutide: A Case Report
pmc-13532928.creator: Anne-Claire Fougerousse
pmc-13532928.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Prurigo nodularis (PN) is a chronic inflammatory dermatosis characterized by intensely pruritic hyperkeratotic nodules affecting the trunk and extremities. Despite an expanding therapeutic armamentarium including dupilumab and nemolizumab, a subset of patients remains inadequately controlled. Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs), widely used in the management of type 2 diabetes and obesity, have provided emerging evidence supporting immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory effects in several chronic inflammatory dermatoses.

pmc-13576586.title: The Unfinished Journey After Major Surgery: Interhospital Transfer and Care Fragmentation
pmc-13576586.creator: Rida Ejaz, Qaidar Alizai, Lorenza Arena, Kizuki Yuza, Charalampos M Charalampous, Abdulaziz Elemosho, Timothy M Pawlik
pmc-13576586.description: BackgroundInterhospital transfer (IHTR) is commonly used to access specialized surgical care, yet post‐discharge readmission destination among transferred surgical patients remains poorly characterized. Therefore, the association of IHTR and hospital transfer burden with care fragmentation after major surgery was evaluated.MethodsAdults aged ≥ 18 years undergoing major surgery between 2016 and 2020 were identified from the Nationwide Readmissions Database.
